title: The cleanup RPC also deletes kept skips past the newest 200, so a skipped comment can be evaluated again
evidence: Was: not started (triage 2026-11-25 named root fix R28). Done 2026-11-17, US-15 AC68 (branch claude/yt-followup-once, PR 1866): cleanupSkippedRows deletes posted=false rows only past COMMENT_MAX_AGE_DAYS plus a day, from code; no SQL change was needed (the RPC is no longer called). Seen live: chat-health W46, three follow-ups ran twice. supabase/rls-policies.sql youtube_bot_cleanup_skipped deletes every posted=false row past the newest 200, including skips the tick means to keep (app/lib/youtube-bot.server.ts, the shouldUnclaim comment). A later tick can then claim the comment and run the model on it again. Marked rows (posted=true) are kept since C15 (US-27 AC5).
